activity_summary: Ralph Raye had paid Henslowe twelve pence on his own debt and seen yesterday's play, Long Meg, set against the thirtieth. By that book today is the thirty-first of April. The sums were right to the farthing. You said a man may lose a day, and nobody loses a shilling by mistake. Kemp wanted a wage, then offered a thirty-second of May for sixpence, and was not paid it. Pope would have played twice. Heminges kept any sum of that house off the table. Your part was not named.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Proposed playing twice, and kept the meat.

entities.name: Agnes Tipping
entities.context: Kept the dinner on her own slate, and sent the phrase out with the men.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Asked after the sums, feared the farthing more than the day, and closed the plot.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said who knows what matters, and left the king's leaf at home.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked a wage for the invented day, and offered sixpence for a thirty-second of May.

entities.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
entities.context: Paid the twelve pence, reported the page, named Long Meg, and brought no receipt.

entities.name: Philip Henslowe
entities.context: Took the twelve pence and had yesterday's play set against the thirtieth.

entities.name: Long Meg
entities.context: Mentioned in The thirty-first of April

facets.activity: Let a wrong day become the word for never

speakers: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

quotes.speaker: hired_men
quotes.text: By Master Henslowe's book, today is the thirty-first of April.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A man may lose a day. Nobody loses a shilling by mistake.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: I'll sell him a thirty-second of May for sixpence.
